_comment: Copy to webapp/bots.local.json (git-ignored) and describe this machine's extra bots: absolute paths, or paths relative to the project root. Big files can go to webapp/blueprints/ (git-ignored) or anywhere else, e.g. a flash drive. An entry with the same id as in bots.json replaces it; "default" here overrides the shared default. Restart the server after editing.
